noah (PM): Starting a thread to pin down scope + gating for Optimize Toolkit: batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. Need MVP definition, owners, and rollback policy.

li (Eng): Suggest MVP = 1) Recommendations API (per-route suggestions), 2) simple UI for toggles, 3) eval webhook that emits alerts. Implementation notes: runtime needs a light-weight advice path (no inference on path) and a safe fallback to current serving. Blockers: caching invalidation, variant routing.

anya (ML): Eval signals we should wire: concordance (top-k answer matching), perplexity spike threshold, and hallucination classifier score. Propose default thresholds but allow tenant overrides. We need a small eval harness that can run nightly on sample prompts.

ravi (Solutions): Customers repeatedly ask for per-tenant opt-in, audit trail, and a one-line "why" for each recommendation. Example: "why": "use quantized gpt-small to reduce token cost by ~2.1x with <6% concordance loss". SEs need 2 sample curl commands and an SDK snippet.

dina (SRE): Ops constraints: canary traffic cap 3-10% (prefer 5%), p95 target for advisor decision path <= 50ms, and automated rollback when eval-alerts trigger for >4% of cohort for 15m. Logs retention requirement: 90d for audit trail. Also need a kill-switch env var.

fred (ProductOps): I'll own rollout comms and runbook. Proposed rollout steps: alpha -> limited customers (opt-in) -> 5% canary -> widen to 25% -> GA. Docs: runbook, migration guide, sample tenant config, incident checklist.

noah (PM): MVP acceptance (draft):
- Feature: per-route recommendation API + optional `apply_recommendation` flag
- Observability: eval-webhook + alerting + per-tenant metrics dashboard
- Safety: manual opt-in for first 60 days, kill-switch, automated canary rollback rules
- Performance: decision path p95 <= 50ms, no >15% latency regression for serving path when using recommended config
- Quality: nightly eval harness + baseline concordance for supported models, default concordance >= 93%
- Docs & SE: migration guide + 3 SE examples + FAQ

li (Eng): Technical plan sketch: 3-week infra sprint for routing + cache hooks, 1-week to wire the recommendation microservice, 2 weeks for UI and toggle. Total ~6 weeks if nothing blocks. I'll add perf benchmarks to the PR.

anya (ML): I'll deliver an eval harness and sample prompt sets for top-10 customers. Quick callout: for long-context customers we should flag quantization risk separately.

ravi (Solutions): For compliance customers (e.g., regulated healthcare) we'll gate by tenant policy: `allow_quant_recs: false` by default. SEs will get an `explainability` param.

dina (SRE): CI gating: run the eval harness in staging and fail deploy if concordance drop > configured threshold for staging customers. Also want a smoke test that simulates fallback >1% to validate rollback automation.

fred (ProductOps): I'll schedule the cross-functional launch huddle for Friday 09:30 PT and prepare the checklist. Who wants to own post-launch monitoring?

li (Eng): I'll own the monitoring knobs and dashboard wiring.

noah (PM): Owners recap: Li = eng/features + perf; Anya = eval harness + baselines; Dina = rollback automation + smoke tests; Fred = runbook/comms; Ravi = SE materials.

deploy-bot: Created initial draft runbook at /playbooks/optimize-toolkit/runbook-draft.md

noah (PM): Next steps: Li to drop an RFC with sequence diagrams and API shape by EOD Wed; Anya to share baseline numbers; Dina to draft rollback automation spec. Keep notes short in this thread. Thanks!
